minimal.title: Minimal
minimal.hint: Logo and words only, centred in the first screen.

wall.title: Photo wall
wall.hint: Text beside slowly moving columns of recent photos.

filmstrip.title: Filmstrip
filmstrip.hint: Centred text above two rows of photos drifting sideways.

mosaic.title: Mosaic
mosaic.hint: Text beside an editorial grid of five recent photos.

home.title: Home page
home.hint: Photo styles need a few public photos; with too few, the minimal style is shown until there are more.

identity.name: Archive name
identity.taglineHint: small line above the home page heading

colors.title: Brand colours
colors.hint: Choose the two colours of your organisation. The shades for hover, selection and the dark theme are worked out from them, and text on them is kept readable.
colors.darkerInLight: Your primary colour is light, so the light theme uses a darker shade of it to stay visible.
colors.lighterInDark: Your primary colour is dark, so the dark theme uses a lighter shade of it.
colors.darkLabels: Button labels are set in dark text, because white would be hard to read on this colour.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF, square works best. Also used as the browser icon.

form.emptyHint: Empty fields go back to the defaults.
form.saved: Saved. Every visitor sees the new branding now.
form.friendsOn: Friends area on. Set by FRIENDS_ENABLED on the server.
form.friendsOff: Friends area off. Set by FRIENDS_ENABLED on the server.
